LanguageData.RT_Kurganets25_Vehicle.label: Kurganets-25 IFV
LanguageData.RT_Kurganets25_Vehicle.description:
Next-generation tracked Russian IFV platform equipped with an unmanned 57mm module, Kornet ATGMs, and Bulat mini-missiles.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1, Commander x1, Passenger x8 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 57mm Epoch Module: 57mm 3OF91 (AP-HE), 57mm 3UBM21 APDS (Sabot) - Kornet ATGM: 9M133 "Kornet"AntiTank missile(HEAT) - Bulat Mini-Missiles: "Blart" mini missile(Thermobaric) - 7.62mm PKT MG: 7.62x54mmR cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP)
